title: EnhancedArmor+
description: Adds more armor out of different things
body:
**Enhanced Armor+**



Expanded armor progression for Minecraft.



Enhanced Armor+ is a mod that adds a wide variety of new armor sets crafted from materials found throughout the Minecraft world. From Stone and Diorite to Deepslate and many more, each armor set provides unique protection, durability, and visual styles while fitting naturally into vanilla gameplay.



**Examples include:**



Stone Armor

Diorite Armor

Deepslate Armor

And more!

Features

Adds multiple new armor sets made from vanilla materials

Unique stats and durability for each armor type

Balanced progression that complements vanilla Minecraft

Custom textures and models

Regular updates with new armor sets and features

**Requirements**

This mod requires the appropriate mod loader and any listed dependencies to be installed.



**Support & Community**



Join the Discord server for support, updates, sneak peeks, and community discussions:
